entity_types.name: Method
entity_types.description: A specific algorithm, framework, or system proposed for GraphRAG or related tasks (e.g., retrieval, generation, or LLM integration). Includes model architectures (GNNs, LLMs) used as pipeline components.

properties.name: category
properties.description: The primary function of the method (e.g., Retrieval, Generation, Indexing).

properties.name: year
properties.description: The year the method was proposed or published.

properties.name: technique
properties.description: Key technical components (e.g., GNN, LLM, Non-parametric).

entity_types.name: KnowledgeGraph
entity_types.description: A structured database of entities and relationships used as an external knowledge source for RAG.

properties.name: domain
properties.description: The specific field of knowledge (e.g., Biomedical, Movie, Commonsense).

properties.name: structure_type
properties.description: The type of graph structure (e.g., Semantic Network, Causal Graph).

properties.name: source
properties.description: The origin or construction method of the graph.

entity_types.name: Dataset
entity_types.description: A collection of data used for training, evaluation, or benchmarking GraphRAG systems.

properties.name: task_type
properties.description: The specific task the dataset is designed for (e.g., QA, Classification).

properties.name: size
properties.description: Indication of scale or number of instances.

properties.name: language
properties.description: Primary language of the data.

entity_types.name: Task
entity_types.description: A specific downstream application or problem type addressed by GraphRAG.

properties.name: type
properties.description: Classification of the task (e.g., Discriminative, Generative).

properties.name: complexity
properties.description: Level of reasoning required (e.g., Multi-hop, Single-hop).

entity_types.name: Metric
entity_types.description: A quantitative measure used to evaluate the performance of GraphRAG systems.

properties.name: category
properties.description: What aspect is measured (e.g., Retrieval Quality, Generation Quality).

properties.name: formula_type
properties.description: Type of calculation (e.g., Rank-based, Accuracy).

entity_types.name: Organization
entity_types.description: An academic institution, company, or research group associated with the authors or development of methods. Includes conferences and journals as publication venues.

properties.name: type
properties.description: Nature of the organization (e.g., University, Tech Company).

properties.name: location
properties.description: Geographic location.

entity_types.name: Person
entity_types.description: An author, researcher, or contributor mentioned in the text.

properties.name: affiliation
properties.description: Primary institutional affiliation.

properties.name: role
properties.description: Role in the work (e.g., Author, Corresponding Author).

entity_types.name: Paper
entity_types.description: A specific academic publication or survey article.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Full title of the paper.

properties.name: publication_date
properties.description: Date of publication.

properties.name: venue
properties.description: Journal or conference name.

entity_types.name: Technique
entity_types.description: A specific procedural step or algorithmic strategy used within a method (e.g., a type of retrieval or enhancement).

properties.name: stage
properties.description: Phase of the pipeline (e.g., Pre-generation, Retrieval).

properties.name: mechanism
properties.description: How the technique works (e.g., Rewriting, Pruning, Path Extraction).

entity_types.name: Domain
entity_types.description: A specific field of application or knowledge area.

properties.name: level
properties.description: Scope of the domain (e.g., General, Specialized).

properties.name: examples
properties.description: Representative entities in this domain.

relationship_types.name: PROPOSED_BY
relationship_types.description: Indicates the person or organization that developed the method or model.

relationship_types.name: USES_KNOWLEDGE_GRAPH
relationship_types.description: Indicates that a method or system utilizes a specific knowledge graph as its data source.

relationship_types.name: EVALUATED_ON
relationship_types.description: Indicates that a method was tested or benchmarked on a specific dataset.

relationship_types.name: SOLVES_TASK
relationship_types.description: Indicates the specific downstream task that a method is designed to address.

relationship_types.name: MEASURED_BY
relationship_types.description: Indicates the metrics used to evaluate the performance of a method or system.

relationship_types.name: AFFILIATED_WITH
relationship_types.description: Indicates the institutional or organizational affiliation of a person.

relationship_types.name: PUBLISHED_IN
relationship_types.description: Indicates the venue (conference or journal) where a paper was published.

relationship_types.name: AUTHORED_BY
relationship_types.description: Indicates the authors of a specific paper.

relationship_types.name: APPLIES_TECHNIQUE
relationship_types.description: Indicates that a method utilizes a specific procedural technique or strategy.

relationship_types.name: BELONGS_TO_DOMAIN
relationship_types.description: Indicates the specific field of application for a knowledge graph, dataset, or task.

relationship_types.name: CITES
relationship_types.description: Indicates that one paper references or builds upon another paper.

relationship_types.name: DERIVED_FROM
relationship_types.description: Indicates that a knowledge graph or dataset is constructed from or based on another source.

relationship_types.name: IMPROVES_UPON
relationship_types.description: Indicates that a method is an enhancement or variant of a previous method.

relationship_types.name: PART_OF_PIPELINE
relationship_types.description: Indicates that a technique is a component of a larger method's workflow.
